CH.label: Children, approximately ages 6 to 11
CH.adaptation: Short, concrete questions; little writing; therapist support and the child’s own voice; coordinate parent involvement as needed.

TE.label: Adolescents, approximately ages 12 to 17
TE.adaptation: Direct, respectful language; autonomy, belonging and privacy; examples from learning, relationships and family.

AD.label: Adults
AD.adaptation: Examples from work, relationships, family and daily functioning; personal goals and practical exercises.

OA.label: Older adults
OA.adaptation: Readable, spacious text; answering in conversation is an option; adapt to needs and preferences without assuming reduced ability.

ALL.label: Shared across age groups
ALL.adaptation: Shared wording with adaptations as needed. Therapist guides include separate notes for all four age groups.
